{{Quote|Your daughter is safe now.''"<br />"''Do you really believe that?|Ahsoka Tano and Cad Bane, to Roo-Roo Page's mother|<ref name="CotF" />}}
'''Roo-Roo Page''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] born in [[Jan-gwa city/Legends|Jan-gwa city]] on her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. During her infancy, Page was discovered to be [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], information that was eventually revealed to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. The Order entered Page's name into a database of all known [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-sensitive children known as the [[Kyber memory crystal/Legends|Kyber crystal]], which would later be [[Raid on the Jedi Temple/Legends|stolen]] by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] on behalf of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Sidious and Bane planned to kidnap the children on the [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]], but the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] [[Force vision/Legends|anticipated]] the plan and [[Attempted kidnapping of Roo-Roo Page/Legends|dispatched]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], to Naboo after determining that Page would be one of the targets. Page was taken to safety while the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] set up a trap for Bane with the assistance of [[Roo-Roo Page's mother/Legends|Page's mother]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|The Gungan child was screaming.''"<br />"''The future you see, young Skywalker. To Naboo, you must go.|Anakin Skywalker and Yoda, on their vision of Page's kidnapping|<ref name="CotF" />}}
[[File:RooRooPageAndMother-ChildrenOfTheForce.png|thumb|left|200px|Roo-Roo Page with her mother]]
Roo-Roo Page was a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] born on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]<ref name="Cotf Ep. Guide" /> around the beginning of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="SW Annual 2011" /> Living in the [[Water/Legends|waterfall]]-surrounded [[Jan-gwa city/Legends|Jan-gwa city]] with her [[Roo-Roo Page's mother/Legends|mother]], Page was at some point discovered to be [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Learning this, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] entered her identity into the [[Kyber memory crystal/Legends|Kyber crystal]], a [[Memory crystal/Legends|database]] that retained a list of all known Force-sensitive [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="CotF" /> This list was used to recruit the future members of the Order, and was therefore entrusted to the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bolla Ropal/Legends|Bolla Ropal]] for protection.<ref name="CoD">{{TCW|Cargo of Doom}}</ref>

During the Clone Wars, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] of the [[Order of the Sith Lords|Sith Order]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], learned of the information held on the Kyber [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]]. Planning to use the children to create an [[Army/Legends|army]] of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]&ndash;talented [[Spy/Legends|spies]] enslaved to his will, Sidious hired the notorious [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] to [[Raid on the Jedi Temple/Legends|steal the crystal]] from the Jedi Order. After [[Death/Legends|killing]] Ropal, Bane provided Sidious with the crystal's information. Bane was then directed to begin abducting children from the crystal's memory and deliver them to the Dark Lord's [[Darth Sidious's secret facility/Legends|secret facility]] on the volcanic world of [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]].<ref name="CotF" />[[File:Bane_captured.png|thumb|right|250px|Roo-Roo Page watches as Bane is taken into custody.]]Having kidnapped children on [[Glee Anselm/Legends|Glee Anselm]] and [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], Bane turned his sights toward Naboo, where he hoped to capture Roo-Roo Page. However, the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] had anticipated Bane's intentions through the Force, having [[Force vision/Legends|foreseen]] Page's abduction during a [[Meditation/Legends|meditation]] session. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] was [[Attempted kidnapping of Roo-Roo Page/Legends|dispatched]] to Naboo alongside his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]. Led by the Gungan [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Lunker/Legends|Lunker]] to Jan-gwa [[City/Legends|city]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] prepared a [[Attempted kidnapping of Roo-Roo Page/Legends|trap]] for the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter with the assistance of Page's mother. Bane arrived in Jan-gwa shortly after, infiltrating the city and spying on Page's mother as she pretended to put her daughter to rest in her nursery. Once the Gungan mother left the room, Bane sneaked in through an open [[Window/Legends|window]] and approached the infant's bassinet, only to find a [[Tooka doll/Legends|tooka doll]] resting beneath the crib's blanket. After a short struggle with Skywalker and Tano, Bane was apprehended and taken into [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] custody. Once the Duros was safely constrained within [[Binders/Legends|binders]], Page's mother brought her daughter out of hiding, and the cheerful infant was playfully greeted by Tano.<ref name="CotF" />

==Personality and traits==
Page had [[Color/Legends|pink]] and white-colored skin and green [[Eye/Legends|eye]]<nowiki/>s.<ref name="CotF" />

==Equipment==
Page wore green [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] and had purple [[Ribbon/Legends|ribbon]]<nowiki/>s around her ears.<ref name="CotF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Roo-Roo Page was created for the third episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, titled "[[Children of the Force]]." While series director [[Dave Filoni]] indicates in the "Children of the Force" episode commentary that the two other featured infants, [[Wee Dunn/Legends|Wee Dunn]] and [[Zinn Toa/Legends|Zinn Toa]], are taken into the Jedi Order in the aftermath of the episode, Filoni specifically states that Page remains with her mother for some time.<ref name="Ep Comment">{{SW|url=video/children-of-the-force-episode-featurette|text="Children of the Force" Episode Featurette}}</ref>
